pivHint: Be STILL, and know that I am God, the psalmist writes. A single photograph, as opposed to a video, is called a still ______.
winText: You found it. STILL isn't just a word in today's verse — a single photograph is a still PHOTO.
lossText: The word was PHOTO. STILL was the pivot — a single photograph is a still PHOTO.
votdVerse: He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”
passageText: He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.” The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
